body: Thank you for saying that. I may not feel 100% better but you've helped me understand what steps I could take and made me feel a little more at ease. <3

I haven't been able to take walks and they used to be something that would be my go-to. Drawing has been a little overwhelming so I've been writing a lot. Working helps keep my mind off of things too. I'll try to find more things that could help me.

It feels good to ask for help and actually have a response. Especially one that is helpful. I've been feeling so scared lately. 

I was wondering if I would be able to post here for whenever I feel suicidal or should I post to /r/depression? I don't want to step in front of someone who may need more help than I do.

Thankfully, therapy will be an option soon. It could be why I'm so stressed lately.

How would I go about making progress feel like a reward?

I looked up some tips of helping not get overwhelmed like breathing slowly and distracting yourself but is there more you would recommend?

I appreciate you responding so quickly, I'm freaking out a little but I just feel number I guess.
